profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Guild Education and Ph.D. in Music
profile.summary:
I write code that is readable, testable, and robust. I am an avid learner who thrives both in collaboration and when working independently. When tackling a challenge, I first develop a deep understanding of the problem and its context; then I design efficient, stable, and forward-looking solutions; finally, I organize and execute the implementation of those solutions with my teammates and other stakeholders. I have expertise in end-to-end, full-stack software engineering and years of experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining web applications.

As a musicologist, I study the 15th and 16th centuries and am an experienced teacher at the undergraduate and graduate levels.  At the intersection of software development and music research, I am involved in semantic music encoding, digital edition-making, and the development of tools for these purposes and for music education broadly.

positions.title: Co-Creator & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Database of archival collections of film and media music. Collaboration with Michael W. Harris, Ph.D.

- Designed and optimized relational database according to specifications of co-creator
- Implemented database views to simplify queries
- Built intuitive browsing interface

company.name: C2M2: Collections of Cinema and Media Music

positions.title: Co-Creator & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Peer-to-peer, real-time, in-browser, multiplayer snake game. Created to explore peer-to-peer architectures and their challenges for a fast, reflex-based game.

- Implemented conflict free replicated data types (CRDTs)
- Optimized for real-time multiplayer gaming
- Used a predictive model for real-time effect in the presence of latency
- Researched and implemented the most efficient peer-to-peer network topology for our use case
- React/Redux front end, Node.js back end to broker peer-to-peer connections

positions.title: Core Contributing Software Engineer
positions.description:
Open-source software for encoding and engraving music documents.

- Implemented PDF viewer, background saving, and save status indicator
- Refactored toolbars as reusable components; improved usability and uniformity of UI

Component technologies:
- React
- Redux
- MEI (http://music-encoding.org/)
- LilyPond (http://lilypond.org/)
- Abjad (http://abjad.mbrsi.org/)
- Verovio (http://www.verovio.org/)

positions.title: Instructional Designer and Technology Consultant for Arts Administration Certificate Project
positions.description: Proposed and developed new courses for an online and distance-learning certificate program in Arts Administration in conjunction with Music department administrators and working closely with individual instructors.

publications.title: “Anti-Inquisition Propaganda in Music at the Outbreak of the Dutch Revolt: Noé Faignient’s Chansons, madrigales et motetz,” in Tyranny and Music
